Official Main Allergy Menu PDF. It says normal kitchen operations use shared cooking surfaces, utensils and common fryer oil; allergen contact is possible; no menu item is guaranteed entirely free of nut allergens. Its letter codes mean prepared without/can be prepared without, not positive contains claims.
Official Lunch Allergy Menu PDF repeats the shared-surface, utensil, fryer-oil and nut-free guarantee limitations and uses absence/modification letter codes.
